        * { box-sizing: border-box; } body {margin: 0;}body{font-family:Arial, sans-serif;margin-top:0px;margin-right:0px;margin-bottom:0px;margin-left:0px;padding-top:0px;padding-right:0px;padding-bottom:0px;padding-left:0px;background-color:rgb(17, 17, 17);color:rgb(255, 255, 255);}.hero{padding-top:80px;padding-right:20px;padding-bottom:80px;padding-left:20px;text-align:center;background-color:rgb(0, 0, 0);border-bottom-width:2px;border-bottom-style:solid;border-bottom-color:rgb(212, 175, 55);}.hero h1{font-size:3rem;color:rgb(212, 175, 55);margin-bottom:10px;}.hero p{font-size:1.2rem;color:rgb(204, 204, 204);}.container{max-width:1200px;margin-top:0px;margin-right:auto;margin-bottom:0px;margin-left:auto;padding-top:40px;padding-right:20px;padding-bottom:40px;padding-left:20px;}.ciclo-title{width:100%;text-align:center;font-size:2rem;color:rgb(212, 175, 55);margin-top:40px;margin-right:0px;margin-bottom:20px;margin-left:0px;border-bottom-width:1px;border-bottom-style:solid;border-bottom-color:rgb(51, 51, 51);padding-bottom:10px;}.grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;row-gap:20px;column-gap:20px;justify-content:center;}.card{width:300px;background-image:initial;background-position-x:initial;background-position-y:initial;background-size:initial;background-repeat:initial;background-attachment:initial;background-origin:initial;background-clip:initial;background-color:rgb(34, 34, 34);border-top-left-radius:8px;border-top-right-radius:8px;border-bottom-right-radius:8px;border-bottom-left-radius:8px;overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:hidden;}.card img{width:100%;height:400px;object-fit:cover;}.card-body{padding-top:15px;padding-right:15px;padding-bottom:15px;padding-left:15px;}.card-title{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:5px;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);}.card-info{color:rgb(212, 175, 55);font-size:0.9rem;}#igseu{color:rgb(212, 175, 55);font-family:"Open Sans", sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;background-color:rgb(10, 10, 10);}

    <body><header class="hero"><h1 id="ilgc">Antropocine</h1><p id="i7fj"><span id="igseu">Espacio de pensamiento alrededor del cine promovido por estudiantes de Antropología UDES.</span></p></header><section class="container"><!-- Ciclo 1 --><h2 class="ciclo-title">Ciclo: Cine de Terror</h2><div class="grid"><!-- Película 1 --><div class="card"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Poster" id="ic7wj"/><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">La Morgue</div><div class="card-info">Jueves 13, 6:30 pm.</div></div></div><!-- Película 2 --><div class="card"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Poster" id="i8b5i"/><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">´La Casa de Cera</div><div class="card-info">Jueves 20, 6:30 pm.</div></div></div></div><!-- Ciclo 2 --><h2 class="ciclo-title">Ciclo: Cine Francés</h2><div class="grid"><!-- Película 3 --><div class="card"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Poster" id="ixonk"/><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">Titane</div><div class="card-info">Jueves 20, 6:30 pm.</div></div></div><!-- Película 4 --><div class="card"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Poster" id="iryxk"/><div class="card-body"><div class="card-title">Liberté</div><div class="card-info">Jueves 20, 6:30 pm.</div></div></div></div></section></body>
